note: Canonical-hash reputation seed. good=known-trusted (findings suppressed, disclosed as REP-GOOD), malicious=known-bad (raises a REP-BAD critical finding). Every entry must be a REAL curated hash from `aguard hash <path>`: this file feeds the score, so a placeholder record is a false record — the malicious half is empty until curated entries exist rather than carrying an example. A good entry with a `source` must also carry sha, reviewed, reason and the findings fingerprint the review covered; `make reputation-refresh` renews such entries when the official marketplace pins a new commit with the SAME fingerprint, and refuses when it differs. Two sources only: official-marketplace plugins, and Claude Desktop's Anthropic built-in skills (`source: claude-desktop`, sha = the desktop manifest's updatedAt for that skill, path = skills/<name>; renewable only on a machine with the desktop store, via -add-desktop / make reputation-refresh).

entries.name: security-guidance
entries.reason: 66 findings read in source. This plugin hooks SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit, git commit) and Stop, so read this entry as a description of what those hooks do. EXEC-004 x48: subprocess.run with argv lists - git queries in hooks/gitutil.py and hooks/diffstate.py, and hooks/ensure_agent_sdk.py, which at SessionStart creates ~/.claude/security/agent-sdk-venv and pip-installs the claude-agent-sdk package from PyPI when it is missing (a package install at session start, by design and documented in the file). EXFIL-001 hooks/llm.py: reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN and POSTs the session's git diff to ${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL:-https://api.anthropic.com}/v1/messages for the on-stop LLM security review - the same destination and credential Claude Code itself uses; code diffs do leave the machine, to Anthropic. EXEC-005 x4, EXEC-003 x8, BD-002 x4, FS-004 x1: all inside the plugin's own detection material - regex strings and reminder text in hooks/patterns.py and the review prompt in hooks/llm.py - which name new Function() / eval / exec / path traversal as things to warn about; none is executed.

entries.name: docx (Claude Desktop)
entries.reason: All 10 findings read in source. EXEC-004 x6: subprocess.run with argv lists, never a shell string - `soffice --headless` (LibreOffice) to accept tracked changes and to initialise a profile in scripts/accept_changes.py:68/:99 and scripts/office/soffice.py:46; `gcc -shared` in soffice.py:68 compiles a shim from C source embedded in the same file (_SHIM_SOURCE, read in full): it interposes socket()/listen()/accept() so headless LibreOffice can fall back to socketpair() where the sandbox blocks AF_UNIX sockets - it opens no network connection; `git diff --word-diff --no-index` on two temp files in scripts/office/validators/redlining.py:192/:222. INJ-004 x3: the three ECMA-376 OPC .xsd schemas under scripts/office/schemas start with a UTF-8 byte-order mark (EF BB BF) - an encoding marker on schema files no agent reads as instructions, not a hidden character in prose. RES-001 scripts/merge_runs.py:150: `while True` breaks in its else branch as soon as the next sibling is not a mergeable run.
